AI agent for chief editor desicion tasks

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the chief-editor-desicion skill.

- Provides an AI agent specialized for chief editor decision tasks and reporting workflows.
- Implements a two-step workflow: (1) information collection from attachments and URLs, and (2) structured decision reporting with mandatory detailed narrative.
- Requires decisions to be structured with mermaid tree diagrams, MECE logic breakdowns, and rich supporting evidence (10,000+ words, ≥3 charts, ≥50 URL references).
- Enforces strict citation standards: only original URLs from source documents may be cited, never attachment filenames.
- Integrates tool usage for reading attachments, scraping URLs, writing reports, and submitting results according to detailed instructions.
